title: Numbers With Repeated Digits
description: Find the count of positive integers <= n that have at least one repeated digit.

steps.note: Calculate count of unique numbers up to 20: 1..9 (9) + 10, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18, 19 (9). Total unique = 18.
Subtract unique count from total (20 - 18 = 2). The repeated numbers are 11 and 22 is out of range, but wait, 11 is the only one in range.
Return the final count of numbers with at least one repeated digit.
